capabilities: Find files by name, alias or folder path with word-based queries
Search note lines with plain text or JavaScript regular expressions
Preview the note around the selected matching line
Replace matches in one line or in all notes, with groups and case changes
Hide paths per dialog with comma-separated exclude regular expressions
disambiguation: Not a tab or workspace switcher; it finds files by name, alias or folder and also searches and replaces text inside notes.
extras: No settings; exclude patterns are saved per dialog in data.json and dialog sizes are stored per device. On phones the preview is missing and Replace acts on the first result; slow regular expressions are detected and reported per note.
motivation: The author wanted the Go to File, Find in Files and Replace in Files dialogs of IntelliJ IDEA inside Obsidian.
problem: Finding a note by alias or folder path, and replacing text across many notes with regular expressions, is not covered by a single keyboard-driven dialog.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Go to File, Find in Files, and Replace in Files in IntelliJ IDEA.
Some ideas for the query of Go to file come from Another Quick Switcher by Tadashi Aikawa.

summary: Pair of keyboard-driven dialogs that find files by name, alias or folder, and search or replace text across notes with regular expressions.
